messages:
Ravi - Sales: Heads up — Medilife (healthcare prospect) wants a POC. Their security team sent a list: redacted SOC 2 Type II, ISO scope, signed pen-test authorization, KMS/HSM custody doc, network diagram, and confirmation on EU data residency. They want everything in a secured ZIP via GCP signed URL + an NDA-signed transfer. Deadline next Wed. Can we do this?

Nina - Security: We can assemble a redacted SOC2 excerpt and ISO scope. For pen-test auth we need to lock down exact scope — they named a third-party vendor (SafeScan Labs). Important: we won't permit social engineering or any tests against live customer data. Do they want any read-only prod endpoints included?

Ravi - Sales: Their request: scanning of a staging POC cluster and read-only hits to the anonymized EU-hosted API for latency testing. They said the POC will use EU data residency, so we should host artifacts in eu-central GCP bucket and provide signed URL. Also they require a one-page KMS/HSM custody summary showing we use customer-key-under-our-HSM? (they called it KMS boundary).

Sam - SolutionsEng: Technical constraints — we can stand up an EU-scoped POC namespace with anonymized dataset. If they require read-only prod endpoints, we must block write routes and apply rate limits; recommend against testing prod. For scanning: allowlist IPs and schedule a 2-hr window. Also we need to decide whether credentialed scans are allowed — that's higher risk.

Taylor - Infra: I can provision the eu POC cluster and create a temporary GCP signed URL (expires in 72h). We also support SFTP if Legal prefers. Will also produce the network diagram with sanitized hostnames. I will add a short teardown script note and retention policy (artifacts removed after 30 days).

Nina - Security: Pen-test letter must include: explicit hostnames/IP ranges, allowed test types (port scan, vulnerability scanning, authenticated app scans only if we agree), prohibited activities (social engineering, DOS), emergency contact, and a legal signature block. We will sign after Legal reviews the draft.

LegalBot: NDA template required before evidence transfer. Ticket ML-1292 opened for Medilife POC compliance bundle. Owner: Ravi. Upload deadline: 2026-06-10.

Ravi - Sales: Thanks. Can someone confirm whether we can allow credentialed scans if SafeScan provides a non-privileged read-only account? Medilife prefers credentialed for coverage. Also pricing note: Medilife asked about Dedicated POC pricing for 2-week reserved capacity — do we have a quick estimate?

Sam - SolutionsEng: Credentialed scans: acceptable only with a service account limited to read-only scope, no admin privileges, and only for agreed endpoints. We'll require the account to be rotated immediately after the test. For Dedicated POC pricing, engineering needs exact vGPU and throughput; ballpark for 2-week small reserved pool is $6k-$9k. Suggest sales ops deliver exact quote.

Nina - Security: I'll draft the pen-test authorization with the SafeScan details and the read-only credential conditions, then route to Legal. Expect draft by EOD tomorrow.

Taylor - Infra: I'll create the eu upload container and generate a 72h signed URL once Legal confirms NDA. ETA tomorrow AM. Will also include the network diagram and KMS summary (HSM use, rotation cadence).

Ravi - Sales: Great — I'll send Medilife the NDA and confirm if they accept GCP signed URL vs SFTP. I'll book a 15m sync for Legal + Security if they need to sign the pen-test letter. Thanks everyone :pray:
__notes: Slack thread: Medilife POC compliance evidence, pen-test scope, data residency and pricing query. No title field per agents.md.
